questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示‘由于’之意。

questions.question: Although the deadline was tight, the team managed to finish the audit ______.
questions.explanation: on time 准时；in time 来得及。此处表示按时完成，选 on time。

questions.question: Since January, the company ______ three new office branches in Asia.
questions.explanation: 自某个过去时间点起至今，使用现在完成时 has/have + 过去分词。

questions.question: The manager, together with his assistants, ______ attending the conference next week.
questions.explanation: 主语是 manager（单数），together with 短语不影响谓语单复数，用 is。

questions.question: The new software works ______ than the previous version.
questions.explanation: 比较级修饰动词 works，需用副词 more efficiently。

questions.question: Employees ______ meet the sales target will receive a bonus.
questions.explanation: 定语从句修饰 Employees（人），主语关系代词 who。

questions.question: This quarter's revenue is ______ last quarter's.
questions.explanation: as ... as 结构表示‘和……一样’，选 as high as。

questions.question: The CEO presented the awards ______.
questions.explanation: 主语是 CEO（女），需反身代词 herself 表示亲自。

questions.question: When planning the budget, we must ______ unexpected expenses.
questions.explanation: take into account 是固定搭配，意为‘考虑到’。

questions.question: ______ have we seen such a significant drop in customer satisfaction.
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 放句首需部分倒装，结构为 Never + 辅助动词 + 主语 + 动词。

questions.question: The project continued ______ the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: despite 表示‘尽管’，后接名词短语。

questions.question: By the time the manager arrived, the meeting ______ already.
questions.explanation: 过去完成时表示‘过去的过去’，由 had + 过去分词。

questions.question: The staff ______ required to attend the training session.
questions.explanation: staff 为集合名词，可视为复数，表示全体成员，用 are。

questions.question: She handled the client complaint ______ and professionally.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 handled，需副词 efficiently。

questions.question: Mr. Tanaka, ______ joined the company last year, has been promoted to team leader.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句，补充说明 Mr. Tanaka，用 who。

questions.question: The new marketing strategy is ______ effective than the old one.
questions.explanation: 比较级结构 more ... than，表示‘更……’。

questions.question: ______ of the reports were inaccurate; we need to revise them.
questions.explanation: Some 表示‘一些’，后接复数名词 reports。

questions.question: We ______ receiving your feedback on the proposal.
questions.explanation: look forward to 是固定搭配，后接动名词 receiving。

questions.question: The IT department ______ the system upgrade next weekend.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时表示已安排的未来动作，is performing。

questions.question: ______ the sales forecast, demand will rise next quarter.
questions.explanation: According to 表示‘根据’，后接名词短语。

questions.question: Either the manager or the supervisors ______ responsible for the error.
questions.explanation: either...or 结构，谓语与最近的主语 supervisors（复数）保持一致，用 are。

questions.question: The success of the event depended on thorough ______.
questions.explanation: 依赖于名词 preparation，意为‘准备’。

questions.question: The client ______ we met yesterday is interested in a long-term contract.
questions.explanation: 定语从句中作宾语，关系代词 whom（可省略），但选项中有 whom。

questions.question: Please submit the form by Friday; ______, it will not be processed.
questions.explanation: otherwise 表示‘否则’，用于警告后果。

questions.question: By June 30, the company ______ its expansion plan.
questions.explanation: 将来完成时表示‘将来的过去’，will have + 过去分词。

questions.question: ______ the risks, the board approved the investment.
questions.explanation: In spite of 表示‘尽管’，后接名词短语。

questions.question: None of the applicants ______ the required qualifications.
questions.explanation: none of 后接复数名词，谓语可用复数 have，表示‘没有一个……有’。

questions.question: He spoke ______ during the presentation, ensuring everyone understood.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 spoke，需副词 clearly。

questions.question: This year's turnover is not ______ as last year's.
questions.explanation: 否定结构 not so ... as，表示‘不如……’。

questions.question: The department head praised ______ team for their hard work.
questions.explanation: 团队由多人组成，用他们的团队 their team。

questions.question: She decided to ______ the position after reading the job description.
questions.explanation: apply for 表示‘申请’某个职位。

questions.question: At 10 a.m. yesterday, the trainer ______ the new software to the staff.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，was demonstrating。

questions.question: ______ your inquiry, please find the attached document.
questions.explanation: Regarding 表示‘关于’，常用于信件开头。

questions.question: The number of employees ______ increased over the past year.
questions.explanation: The number of 为单数主语，谓语用 has。

questions.question: The solution was considered ______ by the committee.
questions.explanation: 主语 solution 后系动词 was considered，需形容词作表语，effective。

questions.question: ______ the manager was on vacation, the assistant handled all client calls.
questions.explanation: While 表示‘……期间’，引导时间状语从句。

questions.question: She ______ for the company for five years and now feels ready for a promotion.
questions.explanation: 强调持续到现在的动作，现在完成进行时 has been working。

questions.question: ______ a few minor typos, the report was well written.
questions.explanation: Apart from 表示‘除了……之外’，后接名词短语。

questions.question: Each of the managers ______ a copy of the revised policy.
questions.explanation: Each of 后接复数名词，但每个视为单位，谓语单数 receives。
